dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Graffiti Alliance HQ... It might just look like a normal house, but still!

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: If you're looking for one or more of our members, I regret to inform you that a couple hundred of them are busy painting all over Natlan, while others are busy managing their lives.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: They only visit HQ to pay membership fees, or when seeking out technical assistance.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: Anyone from Natlan you see holding a spray can and paint bucket is probably one of ours.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: If you want to visit, feel free to do so any time.

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: But you won't find any of our alliance members' exquisite masterpieces here — those are scattered all over Natlan.
